notablePrerequisites:
Infinite Reflection attached to Sharuum.
You have a way to cause another artifact creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause another artifact creature to enter the battlefield as a copy of Sharuum.
Put the copy of Sharuum into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The copy of Sharuum's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning an artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Sharuum.
Repeat from step 2.
